post.title: Why 57% of UnitedHealth's profit came from Optum
post.ig:
57% of UnitedHealth's profit didn't come from insurance.
In Q3 2026, Optum earned $3.7B in earnings from operations vs $2.8B at UnitedHealthcare (our math: 57% of $6.6B).
Optum's revenue grew from $136.3B in 2020 to $270.6B in 2025.
CMS's 80/20 rule makes insurers spend 80-85% of premiums on care; that caps the insurer, not the providers and pharmacy business it owns.
In 2025, about $168B of sales between UnitedHealth's own businesses was eliminated.
Sources: UnitedHealth Group FY2025 and Q3 2026 earnings releases (SEC 8-K), CMS, WSJ.
